To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the DX centre breakdown is a persistent process, which is related to impact of free hot carriers on DX centres; (2) the DX centre ionization threshold is about eV; (3) the impact ionization coefficient of DX centres is about cm V.
the breakdown of AlGaAs/GaNAs heterojunctions is due to impact ionization by hot electrons, and the impact ionization coefficient is strongly dependent on the electric field.
the breakdown in AlGaAs/Gas structures is related to impact excitation of DX centres.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the dynamical electrical breakdown in AlGaAs/Gas heterojunctions.
the investigation of the electrical breakdown in submicrometer AlGaAs/G aAs structures.
the study of the dynamical electrical breakdown in submicrometer AlGaAs/GaN structures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the DX centre is the dominant mechanism responsible for breakdown in the nanoseconde time scale.
the dynamical DX centre breakdown is a process which is related to impact excitation of DX centres by hot free electrons and holes.
the breakdown in AlGaAs/Gas structures is caused by the impact ionization of the DX centres.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the DX centre breakdown in AlGaAs/Gas diodes is a dynamical process which is related to impact excitation of the DX centres by hot carriers.
we have found that the DX centre is a major contributor to the breakdown of AlxGa1−xAs/GaAs heterojunction diodes.
DX centres in AlGaAs/GaxGa1−xAs structures can be considered as an important source of electrical conduction in the nanoseconde time scale.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the breakdown mechanism of the DX centres in submicrometres structures is similar to that of bulk GaAs.

the DX centre breakdown in the submicrometre diodes can be explained by the same mechanisms as in the bulk samples, and that the impact ionization of the DX centres is the main process leading to the breakdown.
the impact ionization of deep levels in the depletion region can cause the dynamical breakdown of the device.
